definitions.gloss: short sentence; short passage; brief text
definitions.explanation: A sentence or passage that is short in length. Often used in language learning, exams, and writing exercises to describe brief pieces of text.

examples.japanese: {短文|たんぶん}を{書|か}く{練習|れんしゅう}をした。
{試験|しけん}では{短文|たんぶん}を{英語|えいご}に{訳|やく}す{問題|もんだい}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: On the exam, there were questions where you had to translate short sentences into English.

examples.japanese: メッセージは{短文|たんぶん}で{簡潔|かんけつ}に{書|か}いたほうが{伝|つた}わりやすい。
examples.english: Messages are easier to understand when written as short, concise sentences.

notes:
USAGE:
{短文|たんぶん} is a compound of {短|たん} (short) + {文|ぶん} (sentence/text). It is used in academic and educational contexts such as language tests, writing practice, and composition classes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短文|たんぶん}を{書|か}く (write a short sentence)
- {短文|たんぶん}{作成|さくせい} (composing a short passage)
- {短文|たんぶん}{読解|どっかい} (short passage comprehension)

RELATED TERMS:
- {長文|ちょうぶん} is the opposite, meaning a long passage or text.
- {例文|れいぶん} means example sentence.
- {作文|さくぶん} means composition or essay.
